desc: Check for forbidden practices: server-side Next.js, wrong icon libraries, inline CSS, jQuery
context: Scan all ui/src component files for: (1) Next.js server-side imports (getServerSideProps, getStaticProps, server actions, next/server, use server); (2) icon library imports that are NOT from react-icons/ri (Remix icons); (3) inline style={{ }} attributes that should use Tailwind classes; (4) any jQuery usage. Check package.json imports too.
acceptance_criteria: All files scanned for server-side Next.js features
All icon imports audited for non-Remix icon usage
Inline CSS style attributes identified by file:line
